ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: the figure is a schematic map of China, marked with regions such as G, E, F, I, and H; I is marked in the plateau region in the western and southern part of China, corresponding to the Qinghai-Tibet Plateau area. Then reason: the question stem asks to complete “Location I in the figure ______, receiving a large amount of solar radiation,” and this is the statement that is “not included among the main reasons why solar energy resources are abundant at location I in the figure.” The real main reasons why solar energy resources are abundant on the Qinghai-Tibet Plateau include high altitude, thin air, weak atmospheric weakening effect, and strong sunshine, etc.; “is close to the Sun” is not a main reason, because the difference in distance between places on the ground and the Sun is extremely small relative to the Earth-Sun distance. Therefore the blank should be completed with “is close to the Sun.”
